hero_subtitulo: An unforgettable culinary experience in the heart of Madrid
filosofia_texto: Respecting seasonal produce and working with the highest quality, we offer our "tapas-raciones" to enjoy an unforgettable culinary experience. We have renewed our original concept by expanding our menu so you can enjoy from the daily menu to an elaborate menu with a selection of our most established dishes.
direccion: VI COOL TAPAS BAR, C/ Huertas, 12, 28012 Madrid
